title: MP2T: Store stream types for PIDs from the Program Map Table
description:
Store the stream types for PIDs seen in the Program Map Table
(if current), and when dissecting PES, send the stream type to the
MPEG PES dissector.

Needed to handle Transport Streams that carry audio and video formats
other than MPEG-1/2.
